posts.headline: Six straight editions of silence from the champs is its own answer — Thicks and the #FreeMaxx dynasty are hoping this league forgets the ring is propping up a 14-14 career record and a brutal 5.5 average finish.
posts.detail: Two seasons, one title, and an .500 record that says the crown is doing all the heavy lifting. Silence isn't confidence, it's a dodge.

posts.headline: Seven editions and counting — One Nut Barner still hasn't said a word, and Put it in Ra's absurd 20-8 record with a 1.5 average finish and zero rings is officially the longest-running injustice in Busters Anonymous history.
posts.detail: A .714 win percentage and back-to-back finishes of 1st and 2nd with NOTHING to show for it — this league owes him a ring or an explanation, and he won't even ask for either.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh keeps getting fresh editions and keeps doing nothing to shake the title of worst résumé in the league — a 4-10 record and dead-last 12th-place finish that's aged like milk.
posts.detail: The untalented tenth had a whole offseason to cook up a redemption arc and instead delivered five straight days of the same silence that got him to 12th place in the first place.

posts.headline: Sasinci's World has run out of days to explain how Big Head's title banner coexists with a losing 13-15 career record — the season starts now and the excuses officially expire.
posts.detail: A ring and a losing record don't add up, and four straight editions of dodging the math hasn't changed a single digit of that 13-15.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy Way or the Hard Way is still stuck defending a rookie 6-8 season and a 10th-place finish, and Auntie Thomas has given this league zero reason yet to expect anything different this time around.
posts.detail: One season, one finish, dead last territory — the scars from that 10th-place debut are still fresh and nothing in the silence since has suggested a turnaround is coming.
